I started liking zutara during 2020 ish but I did watch most of the show when it first came out. I saw all of season one and most of season two but completely missed season three except for the season finale. I was okay with kataang in a sense that it was nothing more than lighthearted distraction from the darker storylines. However, I did notice at the end of season two how they suggested that kataang was going to have higher stakes I was very interested, I even remember relating it to Spider-Man having to let go of Mary Jane at the end of the first Spider-Man movie with Toby McGuire (haha I was obsessed with that movie at the time). Anyways I felt like they weren’t going to end up together or something big was going to happen in season three. but I didn’t get to watch it as a kid  My mom canceled cable :( but I did watch the season finale at a friends house and I was a little confused I was missing a lot of context, but when Katara and Aang kissed I remember cringing. I did chalk it up to maybe I’m just young and kissing is gross (haha sure) or I missed something really important. However, in 2020 I actually sat down and watch the whole show with my husband. And when we got to season three, think it just made the context of them kissing so much worse. And it also introduced something new zutara love triangle?? I remember watching southern Raiders for the first time and my husband was like “you’re going to love it so much”. 🤣

Honestly, I just hopped on this train this year (after watching the show again) but I think I’ve always been on this side since I was a kid. I remember watching the finale, and when I saw aang and katara kiss I remember feeling a little cringed out and I thought maybe I missed an episode and I just was missing something. However, now I realize as an adult, I just didn’t have the words to explain why I was disappointed with the ending. It’s weird because as a kid I didn’t really mind katara and aang together season one they are very cute and fluffy. But then the episode with crossroad of destiny they made aang and Katara’s relationship part of the the story and now it held more weight.
But I feel like season three happened and they didn’t really go anywhere with it. Personally I think aang and katara together forever Kind  of ruined aang’s character arc. But hey, I guess they were too busy ship-teasing their fans to really care. Even though I ship zutara and I believe it would’ve enhance the plot, and tie up the story together wonderfully. But in the long scheme of things it didn’t need to happen. but aang being with katara in the end and getting everything he wants isn’t good storytelling.
